scenario: Cache plane verbs (`cache`, `cache_delete`) are language primitives per LIMP.3.3.3 — declared in [LGRA.10], not services declared in a stdlib library. They do not require an import. Pin: a rule using `cache` and `cache_delete` compiles with NO `import` directive of any kind, so neither verb needs one. `cached(...)` is a primitive too; it is not exercised here.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    cache key: "k" value: 1
    cache_delete key: "old"
